exposure: Use of Leukomed® Sorbact® (Essity) bacteria binding wound dressing
cohort: Women who underwent caesarean section at Barking, Havering & Redbridge University Hospitals NHS Trust, London, UK (BHRUT) maternity unit
finding: The use of Leukomed Sorbact dressings after Caesarean section resulted in a 38% reduction in SSI rates, a 31% reduction in SSI readmission rates, a 38% reduction in readmission bed days, and a 30% reduction in antibiotic use compared to Mepore wound dressings.
mod_finding: This study focused on surgical site infections following cesarean sections but did not compare outcomes based on mode of delivery.
